HISTORICAL RECORDS (unchanged)

# Local Studio service subset

This is the exact static import closure of `lib/loader.js` and `lib/scean-integration.js` from the user-authorized private Card Studio 1.2.0-scean.2 integration copy. The 33 JavaScript files are unchanged; hashes and provenance are in `source-manifest.json`, and the source package manifest is retained as `SOURCE-PACKAGE.json`.

This subset is not the complete Studio distribution and is not the formal Desktop installation. It contains no skills or their original methodology, generated client, DSH SDK, workspace, cards, sessions, credentials, or logs. `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` is copied unchanged as the original rights record; its references to excluded skills do not mean those skills are bundled here, and no new license grant is asserted. Only private use within the user's authorized project is intended. Public redistribution requires separate rights review.

The isolated bridge uses these real services with a newly created, independent local authoring session. It does not impersonate a formal DSH Agent or read the formal Studio database.
